You will perhaps appreciate my fundamental difficulty in making the statement you have expected me to make. This however, I can say from the house-top that I am as confirmed a believer xn non-violence as I have ever been- You may not know that any violence on the part of the Congress workers 1 have condemned openly and unequivocally. I have even done public penance more than once. I must not weary you with examples. The point  I  wish to make is that on every such occasion I was a free man. This time, the retracing, as 1 have submitted lies with the Government. You will forgive me for expressing an opinion challenging yours. I am certain that nothing but good would have resulted if you had stayed your hand and granted me the interview whidh I had announced on the night erf August 8,1 was to seek. But that was not to be.
